title: b7z9.53.1: C: wire SCHC fragmenter into lichen_link_tx for oversized payloads
description: lichen_link_tx.c:134 calls lichen_schc_compress only; payloads exceeding single-frame size fail -EMSGSIZE. Wire schc_fragmenter_init + fragment emission for compressed payloads that exceed the authenticated frame body. The fragmenter exists and is vector-tested but only called from tests/fuzz.
